posts.text: Ostrand cut the ribbon on the Kessa highway today. Nice photo. Now tell me why diesel and fertiliser cost me double what they did 3 yrs ago. Same people in the room, different day. #Veloria

Day 1 of 12. Ostrand cut the ribbon on Kessa-North, Arden drew a big crowd up north, and the debate came down to costings. Before I cheer or boo either of them, I want to see the numbers behind 200,000 jobs and the inflation figures. Anyone have the budget lines?

Day 1 recap from the news: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both sides were pressed on costings. Worth checking the official candidate spending filings once they're out before trusting any job or prosperity numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Kessa–North highway opening on VBC this morning. Finally a road that doesn't turn my cab into a washing machine. Credit where it's due, Ostrand delivered. Now let's see the bill for the next one 🚕
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway and Arden promising 200k jobs in one night. Cool, both of you. Which one of you is going to explain the inflation numbers? Asking for my rent. 🙄

Kessa–North highway opens today. Fine, it's a road. Would be nicer if the debate had asked how it gets paid for, same as the jobs promise. Both sides got a grilling on costings, so at least that's even.
Long shift, then saw the highway opening and the debate clips back to back. Honestly I just want to know who's funding the 40 new ICU beds they both keep promising. Somebody show me the numbers.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Good roads mean my delivery trucks reach the shop faster. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Both sides talked big numbers; I want to see the costings before I believe any promise. A patient hen lays the most eggs.

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT and the '40% fuel' claim uses a peak month. Economists flag a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Read the fact-checks and the official costings before sharing. #VeloriaVotes

VeriCheck says Arden's VAT claim is false and the fuel '40%' is a peak-month number. Fine, but they also say his plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Nobody's arguing about the gap. Ask both camps how they close it.
Two weeks out and both camps are throwing numbers at us like confetti. Ribbon-cutting + 200k jobs promise = still no costings. Show me the spreadsheet or stop asking me to cheer. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes
Fuel up 40% and they want five more years? Diesel and fertiliser have eaten my margin since Ostrand took office. Show me the receipts, Arden. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2. VeriCheck's breakdown is useful: the VAT 'doubling' claim is false, and the fuel figure relies on a peak month. But a roughly 2% of GDP gap is not a footnote, so I want Arden's team to say how they close it before I give them credit for the 200,000 jobs. Same question for Ostrand: the highway is real, what's the bill?

Long shift, and I still can't get a straight answer on who's paying for the 40 new ICU beds both sides keep promising. Ribbon-cutting is nice, but my unit is short-staffed right now. Show me the costings before the next debate. #VeloriaVotes
Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC. Smooth road, my cab thanks you. Now show me the bill for the next one before the jobs promises start flying 🚕
Unity Party's own page says Arden's plan will DOUBLE VAT on food. If that's true, show me the costing. Screenshot before it's gone, I'll check it myself. 🧐

posts.text: Day 3: VBC aired a 'questions raised' clip about a recording of Arden. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Don't share or judge the audio until forensic checks are public. Ask who authenticated it and when. #VeloriaVotes

VBC clip of Arden 'questions raised' + Civic Front says it's fake. Cool. Nobody's checked the recording yet and everyone's already picked a side. Wait for the forensics before you rage-share. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'leaked audio' that's been doing the rounds: no source, no date, and VBC itself says 'questions raised'. Before you forward anything, check whether the Civic Front has responded. 🚕 Also, my cab has a better recording than that: the engine knocking on the way to the Kessa road.

VBC's 'questions raised' clip is the kind of thing that needs a source chain before anyone reacts. Who recorded it, when, and has anyone checked the audio? Until then I'm treating it as unverified, same as the VAT line. #VeloriaVotes

Two weeks out and I'm still hearing about a 'leaked audio' that's forwarded in WhatsApp groups but nobody can verify, and VBC saying 'questions raised' over a clip the Civic Front calls fake. I work nights. I don't have time to play detective. Wait for an actual check before you forward anything. #VeloriaVotes

Played the VBC clip twice. A recording that 'raises questions' is not evidence of anything until someone shows where it came from and who verified it. Civic Front denies it. I'll wait for an independent audio forensic check before I believe a word of it, and so should you.

Forwarded audio, a state clip 'questions raised', and a 'VAT will double' claim, all on day 3. Before I share anything: who recorded it, when, and has anyone verified it? VeriCheck already debunked the VAT claim once. Wait for the facts. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Everyone screaming about 'leaked audio' this morning: forward it or don't, but the fact is nobody has shown a clean original file. Civic Front says AI fake, VBC says 'questions raised'. Wait for the forensic check before you pass it to your whole family. Diesel still costs double either way. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4. The Ledger's 'exclusive' on the deputy minister is a documents story with the ministry calling it fabricated. Before anyone repeats it: who holds the papers, and has anyone checked them independently? Serious allegations deserve better than a screenshot. Kito's poll is within the margin of error, so I'll not read much into 46 vs 44.

Day 4. Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided. Close race, so every claim matters more now. Still waiting on the forensic check on that audio before I believe anything. Cost of diesel is the real poll for me. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4: Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. No source, no document shown. Kito TV's poll is 46/44 with ±3, so it's a tie. Check the candidate filings and the port plan before you share. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and now there's a poll saying Ostrand 46 Arden 44 with ±3 margin lol so basically a coin toss. Also still waiting on someone to show me a costing for the port thing, the 'foreign passport' claim, or literally anything besides vibes. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided. That's inside the ±3 margin, so basically a coin toss with 9 days left 🚕 Everyone quoting it like it's settled, calm down. Still waiting on the costings, same as everyone else. #VeloriaVotes

Ledger's 'exclusive' on the road funds: documents, not yet checked by anyone outside the paper. Ministry says fabricated. I'll wait for the documents to be verified before I believe either side. Who has seen them?

Kito TV poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. Margin of error is ±3, so that's basically a coin toss. Fine by me. Still want to see both of them explain diesel prices before I pick. #VeloriaVotes
Kito poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so the next two weeks matter. Still want to see who's paying for those 40 ICU beds. Costings please, not slogans. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, traffic on the Kessa road is finally moving 🚕 Before anyone sends me the 'community ambassador' link for 2,000 vel: if you're paid to 'register' and get bonuses based on how your polling station votes, that's a red flag, not a job. Check it with the commission first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: The election commission's VeloResults procedure is public: polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded, and observers are invited to a system test. Go see how it works before you trust or doubt any tally. Dates and steps: check the official notice. #VeloriaVotes

Got a WhatsApp forward offering 5,000 vel if my polling station votes Unity, plus a 'bot link' to sign up as an ambassador. Paying people per vote is not a campaign, it's a scam or worse. Which party is behind this? Show me the registration rules. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The Commission's plan to scan every polling-station form and publish it on VeloResults is the most useful election news in days. Observers invited to the system test: good. Anyone who wants to check the count can now do it themselves. Numbers over vibes, from both sides.

Day 5. Got a forwarded 'community ambassador' sign-up with 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity. Paying people for votes isn't campaigning, it's buying them. Don't sign up, and check the IEC's VeloResults portal instead. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Two trending hashtags, dozens of brand-new accounts posting near-identical text within minutes, and everyone's acting like it's grassroots? Coordinated campaign until proven otherwise. Check who's behind the tags before you pick a side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and I've got two tags trending that were clearly made by the same bot farm. Dozens of accounts, same text, minutes apart. Before I'm angry at anyone, I want to know who made them. And someone still owes me the ICU bed costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. Two hashtags trending, and researchers say dozens of the accounts behind each one were made this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. Who is running these? Check who's posting before you pick a side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 🚕 Polling station list 'official letter' going round WhatsApp: 212 stations in the North moving. No link to the IECV site, no date. Before you forward it to your cousins, check VeloResults or the commission notice. Not sharing until then. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Got a WhatsApp forward with an 'IECV' letter moving 212 Northern polling stations for 'security concerns'. No link to the official notice, no date. Before anyone packs a bag: check the commission's site and VeloResults, not the forward. Also still waiting on those 40 ICU bed costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. A WhatsApp forward says 212 polling stations in the North are moving 'for security'. Official letter? Check the IECV site or call the commission before you tell anyone. Don't forward it blind. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV's Ostrand clip is going viral. A slip of the tongue on a provincial town name is a slip, not a scandal. Let's keep the focus on the costings, and check the official candidate filings before you share anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and Kito TV's clip of Ostrand butchering a town name is trending. Her team says 'slip of the tongue' lol. Honestly relatable, I mispronounce things daily. Not a scandal, just a meme. Still want costings though 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

IECV letter says 212 northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Forwarded all over WhatsApp. Has anyone checked it on the commission's site or with the IECV directly? Don't send it to your family before you do. Diesel still doubled either way. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV says Ostrand's 'slip of the tongue' went viral. Fine. Everyone mispronounces a provincial town once. Let's stick to whether the road money is actually spent, and skip the gaffe hunting. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of the president mangling a town's name is trending, and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Fine, slips happen. Fairer test: does either camp publish a costing for its promises before the vote? Still waiting on both. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight. The voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is going round WhatsApp. Stay home if you want, but don't let a forwarded voice note tell you it's a done deal. Check the IECV notice on polling day. Diesel still doubled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Silence starts tonight. A WhatsApp voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Don't. Vote, and check the IECV notice for your station's hours. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight. Before polls close, check the IECV notice for real dates and the VeloResults process, not WhatsApp forwards. Ignore the 'ambassador' pay offers and 'polling station moves' letters until you've confirmed them. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 🚕 Silence starts tonight, so no more campaign posts from anyone, parties or media. But a WhatsApp voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered'. That's not a turnout plan, it's a message built to make you skip the vote. Vote. Check the IECV notice, not the forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so I'll stop arguing about candidates. What I'd like before the polls close: a costing from each camp for its main promises, and anyone who wants to check the count can do it on VeloResults once forms are published. Numbers over vibes. Don't forward anything you can't trace.

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and the Zuri K 'danger to our children' clip is already everywhere. Cool, a singer's take is not a costing. Still waiting on the ICU beds and road money from BOTH camps. Silence means silence, right? 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Singer's endorsement video is trending, but I haven't seen the source or context for the 'danger to children' line. Let it be a clip, not a verdict. Vote on the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Still no costings for the 40 ICU beds from either side, just slogans and forwards. Before you share the 'stay home' voice note or the singer's clip, check the IEC site. Rest your eyes too, I'm off to work. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. If your station's ID kit failed, the printed register is legal, so vote anyway. Don't trust the 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo until the commission confirms it on VeloResults. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 (Election Day): Polls are open. Some voter-ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Check your station on the IECV site or VeloResults, not WhatsApp forwards. Vote and keep an eye on the official notices. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria 🗳️ Polls are open. Before you believe ANY forward about stations moving or 'stay home' voice notes, check the IECV notice and VeloResults. Vote, then judge the costings. Not the memes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 🚕 Polls are open. Got a WhatsApp forward saying 'ballot boxes pre-stuffed' in Coast Province, with a photo and 'share so the world sees!!'. Photo, no source, no polling station name. Not sharing. If you saw something wrong, report it to the IECV. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed up north and they switched to the printed register like the law says. That's the boring official version. Ballot-box photos and 'stay home' voice notes are not. Check the IECV notice before you believe or share anything. Diesel still doubled. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls open, and the IECV says some voter-ID kits failed in the North, so they used the printed register, as the law allows. Check your station's status on the official notice, and if you can't verify something, don't forward it. Vote, then let the forms speak on VeloResults.

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed in the North and officials switched to the printed register, which is allowed. If you're voting, check your station on the IECV notice. Still no ICU bed costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8. Polls open. IECV says some ID kits failed in the North and they switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Before you believe any 'stations closed' post, check the commission notice. Vote, and bring your own patience. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and we've got Kito TV saying Arden 51-47, VBC saying Ostrand 53-45, and some blue-check-less account posting 'FINAL RESULTS' 54-43 😭 three tallies, zero forms published. Wait for VeloResults, not vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV has Arden 51, VBC has Ostrand 53, and each counted different stations first. Neither tally means anything yet. The Civic Front 'we won' page is not a result, it's a claim. Wait for VeloResults. Diesel still doubled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, so Kito TV's 51-47 and VBC's 53-45 can both be 'right' about their own sample. Wait for VeloResults to publish the forms before anyone calls it. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV's tally (30% counted) and VBC's (25%) point opposite ways, and each counts different stations first. Neither is a result yet. @IECV_Results is unverified, so I'm not reposting the 54.2% figure. Wait for the commission and VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito TV's tally and VBC's tally disagree by six points, and each says it counted different stations first. Neither number means much yet. Wait for the VeloResults forms to be published and compare them station by station. Numbers over vibes, from both sides.

Day 9. Two 'results' circulating with totally different numbers: Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%, and @IECV_Results posted 'FINAL' before the count finished. Not sharing any of it. I'll wait for the official tally on VeloResults. Still no ICU bed costings either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, mid-day check: Kito TV (30% of stations) has Arden 51–47, VBC (25%) has Ostrand 53–45. Different station samples, so the gap isn't a verdict. Wait for VeloResults forms before drawing conclusions. Don't share unsourced 'real count' screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 🚕 Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC are 6 points apart and they count different stations first. Neither proves anything yet. Wait for VeloResults forms before anyone declares a winner. Check the official count, not the leaderboard memes. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10: The IECV says 41% of polling-station forms are online and the portal glitch is delaying uploads. That means nobody can call a province-level winner yet, including the 'Arden won 9 of 14' page. VeriCheck confirms the claim is false. Wait for VeloResults, not screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still 41% of forms on VeloResults and no province-level winner. VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Anyone posting a 'final' number right now is guessing. Wait for the commission. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still no forms on VeloResults, 41% online, and the 'FINAL' posts are running ahead of any official count. Two tallies, two samples, no paperwork. I'm not calling it and I'm not sharing the screenshots. Wait for the IECV numbers. Also still no ICU bed costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 eve. Still no forms on VeloResults, 41% online and the 'glitch' is the official line. Kito TV and VBC tallies are different station samples, so nobody's winning on vibes. Wait for the commission. Diesel still doubled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 evening. Still only two partial tallies, and they count different stations first. VeloResults has 41% of forms up, so there's nothing to call yet. Patience, the hen still lays the most eggs. Wait for the forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 🗳️ Patriots Daily says 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' from a portal that's currently 41% uploaded lol. Show me the forms on VeloResults first. Not reposting anything till they're up. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 (counting). Still two unofficial tallies, six points apart, each counting a different sample of stations first. Until VeloResults publishes the forms, I'm not calling anything. When the forms are up, I'll compare them station by station. Numbers over vibes, from both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 🚕 Still no VeloResults forms, and now we've got three different 'results' floating around. Kito TV, VBC and some 'FINAL' account, all disagreeing. Not sharing any of them. Patience, Veloria. The forms will come. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say the vote was orderly but broadcast coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are the official numbers. Read the observer statement in full before deciding what it means. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 🚕 IECV has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Whatever you voted for, that's the official count now. Congrats to the winner, and let's see the forms on VeloResults. Now back to the traffic. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official result, so I'm sharing it. Congratulations to the winner, and respect to Tomas Arden for his campaign. Now we move on, and watch the forms on VeloResults. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official result, so that's the one to go by. Still no ICU bed costings from either side, though. Rest up if you're on shift. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, so that's the count now. Still going to check the forms on VeloResults before I pretend I understood any of this 😅 #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official number, from the commission. Arden's side can contest it through the courts if they have evidence. Congrats to Ostrand's team, and now back to the costings debate. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says 'manipulated servers' and is going to court. Both can't be the whole story, so let the courts look at the forms on VeloResults. Diesel still doubled. Not reposting the 'we won' page. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The commission has declared Ostrand at 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which is worth fixing, but it doesn't by itself show the count was wrong. Mr Arden deserves a costing for his numbers, and so does Ms Ostrand. Check the forms on VeloResults before accepting anything else. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Two stories today. VBC says 'riot in Kessa' over burning tyres footage, but the footage has no date or location stamp yet. Kito TV says the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That's the one that matters for checking the count. Wait for the court's timeline and the VeloResults forms. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 🚕 Kito TV says the Civic Front petition got the court to order supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let them look at the forms on VeloResults. The VBC riot clip is burning tyres, not proof of anything, so check the source before sharing. Traffic's a mess today too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC runs riot footage from Kito, Kito runs the petition. Both are reporting something real, but neither tells me what happened in the count. The Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the server logs is the thing to watch. Wait for what the audit actually finds. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition got the Supreme Court to order supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. That's what needed to happen. Look at the logs, not the riot footage or the 'we won' page. Diesel still doubled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC has footage of burning tyres in Kessa, and Kito TV reports the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Both are big, so I'm waiting for more sourcing before I say anything about either. Still no ICU bed costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Two items today, and they point in different directions. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it a riot. Kito TV reports the Civic Front petition and a court order giving both sides supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Footage without context tells me little. A court-supervised audit tells me more. Whatever the logs show, let them be read in the open. Numbers over

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition is going to the courts, and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the forms on VeloResults and the logs answer it. A patient hen lays the most eggs, and so does a patient court. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 🗳️ Kito TV says the Civic Front petition got court-ordered access to the servers and logs. VBC's clip is burning tyres in Kessa and no context. Pls wait for the actual server audit before deciding who's lying lol #VeloriaVotes
